newsitem.title: FINLAND: MARIEBERG EYES 20 PCT OF NEW CO - AAMULEHTI.
newsitem.headline: MARIEBERG EYES 20 PCT OF NEW CO - AAMULEHTI.

text.p: Swedish media group Marieberg Tidnings Ab will keep its target to own 20 percent of the group formed by Aamulehti and television broadcaster MTV Oy, Aamulehti CEO Matti Packalen said on Tuesday.
"Marieberg has announced that they will aim for a 20 percent stake also after the merger," Packalen told a news conference.

The new company will be formed at the turn of the year and based on current stakes, Marieberg would be its largest owner, trailed by Finnish Yhtyneet Kuvalehdet and Nokia, he said but declined to give exact figures.
Marieberg announced on January 3 that it had raised its stake in Aamulehti to 27.1 percent and said then it had no plan for further purhcases.
